input.overview: Apollo and add-a-ball Blast Off center on the ten-button countdown. Hit the center rollover buttons until the countdown passes 1, then shoot the lit top-center standup. That opens the right-outlane gate, raises rollover and target values, and lights the lower award lanes for Apollo's 1,000-point Specials or Blast Off's extra balls.
input.simpleOverview: In Apollo or Blast Off, hit the ten center rollover buttons until the countdown advances past 1. Then shoot the lit top-center standup to open the right-outlane save gate, increase rollover and target values, and light the lower award lanes. Apollo scores 1,000-point Specials; Blast Off awards extra balls.
input.summary: Work the center countdown first, then collect the top-center target as soon as it lights. The gate protects the right outlane and the lit lower lanes become the payoff route. A completed countdown also launches the backbox rocket after the ball leaves the playfield.

quickInfo.name: Countdown buttons
quickInfo.summary: Ten center rollover buttons advance the countdown toward and past 1.

quickInfo.name: Top-center target
quickInfo.summary: After the countdown passes 1, the lit standup opens the right-outlane gate and raises target and rollover values.

quickInfo.name: Lower award lanes
quickInfo.summary: The same lit standup enables Apollo's 1,000-point Special lanes or Blast Off's extra-ball lanes.

quickInfo.name: Backbox rocket
quickInfo.summary: A completed countdown launches the rocket when the ball leaves the playfield; its special backbox lane pays the edition's major award.

steps.text: Plunge for a center countdown button, then keep upper rebounds moving across uncollected buttons.
Continue the ten-button countdown until it advances past 1 and lights the top-center target.
Shoot the lit top-center standup to open the right-outlane gate and raise rollover and target values.
Use the protected right side and collect a lit lower award lane when its feed is controllable.
If the ball drains after the completed countdown, watch the backbox rocket for the special lane award.

buildsToward.title: An open right-outlane gate and lit lower awards

steps.text: Hit the newly lit top-center standup.
Collect a lit lower award lane with the right-side gate open.

machineSetup: Identify Apollo's replay/point version versus Blast Off's add-a-ball version. Confirm award conversions, ball count, and whether extra balls are enabled.
Test all ten countdown buttons and lamps, top-center target and lamp, right-outlane gate, lower award lanes, target-value advances, backbox rocket and special lane, bumpers, and tilt response.
